formName: Step 7 - Co-applicant - Add an Individual - Water Licence Application
formDescription: This popup collects the legal name and email address for an individual co-applicant. Field keys and ids use data-id values from the source HTML when present; Cancel and Save have no data-id, so their element ids are used.

LastName.title: Last Name:
LastName.description: The legal last name of the individual co-applicant.

FirstName.title: First Name:
FirstName.description: The legal first name of the individual co-applicant.

MiddleName.title: Middle Name:
MiddleName.description: The legal middle name of the individual co-applicant, if applicable.

Email.title: Email:
Email.description: Email address for the individual co-applicant.

cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.title: Save
cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.description: Saves the individual co-applicant details entered directly by the user.
